newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Intel sees no slow down in growth.
newsitem.headline: Intel sees no slow down in growth.

text.p: Intel Corp chief executive Andy Grove said on Monday he saw reason to expect a slow down in growth for the semiconductor industry or his company, the world's biggest computer chip maker.
"Our growth basically depends on the growth of the industry," Grove told a news conference at the World Economic Forum in Davos.
"The growth of the industry has...for many years been in the high teens (as a percentage) and I really see no reason in the long-term or the near-term for that number to be different," Grove said.
Intel last month reported that fourth quarter profits more than doubled to $1.9 billion, beating Wall Street estimates and marking the seventh year in a row of record revenues and earnings.
Grove declined to give any more detailed forecast for 1997 when asked by reporters.
